top_news.title: The Score Is Not the Structure: Brain Alignment and Cross-Lingual Transfer
top_news.dek: Researchers argue that common metrics for brain alignment and cross-lingual transfer often fail to account for underlying tool or probe limitations.
top_news.brief: The study demonstrates that similarity scores used to claim shared structure between models and brains—or across languages—are frequently misleading. When probes perform poorly due to language distance, the resulting metrics often reflect probe failure rather than genuine structural alignment.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram showing probe performance degradation across different languages

top_news.title: Command-line tool quickly removes Apple Intelligence from macOS 27
top_news.dek: A new command-line utility allows macOS 27 users to remove Apple Intelligence components, reclaiming over 12GB of storage.
top_news.brief: The tool provides a manual method for users to strip Apple Intelligence features from their system, offering a way to manage disk space and system resources for those who do not utilize the integrated AI capabilities.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal window showing command-line output for storage cleanup

top_news.title: Dust: Pretraining Transformers Without Backpropagation
top_news.dek: Dust introduces a zeroth-order optimization method that enables Transformer pretraining without traditional backpropagation.
top_news.brief: By perturbing activations independently at each token, Dust treats tokens as virtual population members, allowing for parallel evaluation. The method is competitive with backpropagation and suggests that compute-rich environments may favor non-gradient-based training approaches.
top_news.image_alt: Animation illustrating the Dust method for parallel token perturbation

top_news.title: Cohere: North 2: Enterprise AI Without Compromises
top_news.dek: Cohere has launched North 2, a full-stack platform designed to manage agentic AI workflows in enterprise environments.
top_news.brief: North 2 aims to address the trade-offs between security, control, and scalability in enterprise AI. It is built for high-stakes sectors like finance and healthcare, focusing on production-grade deployment of agentic systems.
top_news.image_alt: Dashboard interface for Cohere North 2 agent management

top_news.title: Import AI 475: Swarm scaling; Google DeepMind watermarks biology; and the AI science economy
top_news.dek: Recent analysis explores swarm scaling as a form of inference-scaling and highlights new watermarking techniques for AI-generated biology data.
top_news.brief: The latest Import AI newsletter discusses the utility of AI swarms for rapid capability development and notes Google DeepMind's efforts to watermark AI-generated biological research, emphasizing the evolving AI science economy.
top_news.image_alt: Conceptual graphic representing swarm intelligence scaling

primary.title: Reka AI's omni-model Rho-1 handles text, images, video, and robot control in a single model
primary.summary: Reka AI's Rho-1 is a 19-billion-parameter omni-model that processes and generates text, images, video, and robot control actions in a single neural network. Trained on 320 H100 GPUs in about three months, it uses a fraction of the compute today's top models need. Instead of routing tasks to specialized systems, Rho-1 runs all modalities as tokens in one shared context window.
